description: This file defines a worker class BackupWorker that performs backup operations asynchronously within an Android application. It retrieves a database repository and backup manager to create backups, handling success and failure scenarios.

classes.name: BackupWorker
classes.description: A Worker class extending CoroutineWorker that performs backup operations asynchronously.

methods.name: doWork
methods.description: Overrides the doWork method to perform backup operations, returning success or failure based on execution outcome.
